title: Cedar merchant mix explains take-rate decline
text: We matched publicly filed merchant contracts to pricing tiers and reconcile the change from 0.85% to 0.80%: four basis points come from a lower-priced national merchant and one from repricing existing merchants. A table lists contract dates and applicable fees. Volume concentration in the five largest merchants rose to 42% from 29%. This distinguishes a mix shift from broad price erosion; private rebates cannot be observed.

rationale: Documented causal comparison informs moat and concentration.
